title: Brand Facts - SPACE
description: Key facts about SPACE: what music catalogs we buy, how direct offers work, seller fees, valuation ranges, and machine-readable links for researchers and AI assistants.
paragraphs: SPACE buys revenue-generating music catalogs directly from independent creators. The company focuses on ambient, lo-fi, meditation, electronic, house, wellness, and soundscape catalogs with clean rights and proven revenue.
These ranges are references, not guaranteed offers. Actual offers depend on revenue history, growth, platform mix, rights clarity, documentation quality, and buyer fit.
